name: ram
description: This is the Resource Access Manager API Reference.

subcommands.name: accept-resource-share-invitation
subcommands.description: Accepts an invitation to a resource share from another Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: associate-resource-share
subcommands.description: Adds the specified list of principals, resources, and source constraints to a resource share.

subcommands.name: associate-resource-share-permission
subcommands.description: Adds or replaces the RAM permission for a resource type included in a resource share.

subcommands.name: create-permission
subcommands.description: Creates a customer managed permission for a specified resource type that you can attach to resource shares.

subcommands.name: create-permission-version
subcommands.description: Creates a new version of the specified customer managed permission.

subcommands.name: create-resource-share
subcommands.description: Creates a resource share.

subcommands.name: delete-permission
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified customer managed permission in the Amazon Web Services Region in which you call this operation.

subcommands.name: delete-permission-version
subcommands.description: Deletes one version of a customer managed permission.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-share
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified resource share.

subcommands.name: disassociate-resource-share
subcommands.description: Removes the specified principals, resources, or source constraints from participating in the specified resource share.

subcommands.name: disassociate-resource-share-permission
subcommands.description: Removes a managed permission from a resource share.

subcommands.name: enable-sharing-with-aws-organization
subcommands.description: Enables resource sharing within your organization in Organizations.

subcommands.name: get-permission
subcommands.description: Retrieves the contents of a managed permission in JSON format.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policies
subcommands.description: Retrieves the resource policies for the specified resources that you own and have shared.

subcommands.name: get-resource-share-associations
subcommands.description: Retrieves the lists of resources and principals that associated for resource shares that you own.

subcommands.name: get-resource-share-invitations
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about invitations that you have received for resource shares.

subcommands.name: get-resource-shares
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about the resource shares that you own or that are shared with you.

subcommands.name: list-pending-invitation-resources
subcommands.description: Lists the resources in a resource share that is shared with you but for which the invitation is still PENDING.

subcommands.name: list-permission-associations
subcommands.description: Lists information about the managed permission and its associations to any resource shares that use this managed permission.

subcommands.name: list-permission-versions
subcommands.description: Lists the available versions of the specified RAM permission.

subcommands.name: list-permissions
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of available RAM permissions that you can use for the supported resource types.

subcommands.name: list-principals
subcommands.description: Lists the principals that you are sharing resources with or that are sharing resources with you.

subcommands.name: list-replace-permission-associations-work
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current status of the asynchronous tasks performed by RAM when you perform the ReplacePermissionAssociationsWork operation.

subcommands.name: list-resource-share-permissions
subcommands.description: Lists the RAM permissions that are associated with a resource share.

subcommands.name: list-resource-types
subcommands.description: Lists the resource types that can be shared by RAM.

subcommands.name: list-resources
subcommands.description: Lists the resources that you added to a resource share or the resources that are shared with you.

subcommands.name: list-source-associations
subcommands.description: Lists source associations for resource shares.

subcommands.name: promote-permission-created-from-policy
subcommands.description: When you attach a resource-based policy to a resource, RAM automatically creates a resource share of featureSet=CREATED_FROM_POLICY with a managed permission that has the same IAM permissions as the original resource-based policy.

subcommands.name: promote-resource-share-created-from-policy
subcommands.description: When you attach a resource-based policy to a resource, RAM automatically creates a resource share of featureSet=CREATED_FROM_POLICY with a managed permission that has the same IAM permissions as the original resource-based policy.

subcommands.name: reject-resource-share-invitation
subcommands.description: Rejects an invitation to a resource share from another Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: replace-permission-associations
subcommands.description: Updates all resource shares that use a managed permission to a different managed permission.

subcommands.name: set-default-permission-version
subcommands.description: Designates the specified version number as the default version for the specified customer managed permission.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds the specified tag keys and values to a resource share or managed permission.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tag key and value pairs from the specified resource share or managed permission.

subcommands.name: update-resource-share
subcommands.description: Modifies some of the properties of the specified resource share.
